title: Hermes Bot Fleet production acceptance requirements

semantics.release_pass: Every mandatory requirement has current PASS evidence from its declared target and all evidence checks pass.
semantics.release_fail: Any FAIL, BLOCKED, or SKIPPED mandatory requirement makes the binary release decision FAIL.

target_environments.clean-environment: Fresh isolated target with no inherited fleet state; used for bootstrap, isolated restore, and creation runbooks.
target_environments.live-production: Provisioned fleet; only non-destructive inspection or explicitly safe end-to-end traffic.
target_environments.disposable-fixture: Bounded non-production data/account/resource fixture; destructive and failure injection is prohibited elsewhere.

requirements.requirement: Pin and record repository revision, deployment manifest digest, Hermes/Desktop versions, image digests, and test runner version.
pass_criteria: All revisions and digests are immutable, non-empty, mutually consistent, and map to reviewed artifacts.
failure_rollback_behavior: Fail release; make no infrastructure change.

requirements.requirement: Validate tracked repository, history, generated configuration, logs, and evidence for credentials, private keys, cookies, and credential-bearing URLs.
pass_criteria: All configured scanners report zero unresolved secret findings and evidence uses only opaque handles/digests.
failure_rollback_behavior: Quarantine evidence, rotate any exposed credential outside agent context, remove the exposure, and rerun from REP-001.

requirements.requirement: Prove implementation and operator documentation matches the three locked decisions and names every unsupported or unimplemented capability.
pass_criteria: No contradictory topology, policy, UX, port, identity, isolation, or authority statement; every gap has owner, tracking issue, impact, and blocked capability.
failure_rollback_behavior: Fail release; correct docs or implementation without weakening locked decisions.

requirements.requirement: Verify reproducible clean-environment bootstrap uses only committed manifests and documented human secret provisioning.
pass_criteria: Fresh host reaches pre-service readiness with no undeclared manual step, inherited state, or agent-visible secret.
failure_rollback_behavior: Destroy the clean fixture, repair automation/runbook, and repeat.

requirements.requirement: Record live Azure for Students subscription credit, quota, Central US and East US 2 SKU availability, and current prices before selection.
pass_criteria: Selected region/SKU is available, Ubuntu-compatible, within quota and remaining credit, and is the cheaper feasible option; hourly/monthly estimates and observation time are recorded.
failure_rollback_behavior: Fail before provisioning; select no assumed or unavailable SKU.

requirements.requirement: Inventory the exact resource group, VM, NIC, NSG, encrypted managed disks, private storage, snapshots, diagnostics, budget, and alert resources.
pass_criteria: Exactly the reviewed resources exist with expected ownership/tags/region and no orphaned fleet resource.
failure_rollback_behavior: Fail release; reconcile only through reviewed manifest or remove orphan with approval.

requirements.requirement: Verify VM and every managed disk, snapshot, Blob account/container, and transport path meet encryption and private-access policy.
pass_criteria: Encryption at rest is enabled everywhere; Blob public access is disabled; transport requires TLS; backup namespaces are Bot-scoped.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable affected service, deny backup/restore, revert exposure, and repair encryption before rerun.

requirements.requirement: Verify effective NSG rules contain no Internet inbound allow and no public IP or bootstrap ingress remains.
pass_criteria: Effective Internet-to-VM probes fail for all TCP/UDP ports and Azure shows no public inbound path.
failure_rollback_behavior: Immediately remove exposure using reviewed rollback; stop exposed services and fail release.

requirements.requirement: Verify boot diagnostics and Azure inventory contain metadata only and no prompt, credential, token, browser content, or message body.
pass_criteria: Zero prohibited values or payload classes are present.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable unsafe diagnostic sink, quarantine artifacts, rotate exposed credentials, and fail release.

requirements.requirement: Verify budget and remaining-credit thresholds are configured and current estimated monthly fleet cost remains within the approved student-credit envelope.
pass_criteria: Budget/credit alerts are enabled, recipients are correct, and estimate does not exceed approved available credit.
failure_rollback_behavior: Fail release; stop optional resources and obtain explicit approval for any cost change.

requirements.requirement: Verify host listeners and publications match the locked port matrix.
pass_criteria: Only SSH 22 and private proxy 443 bind the Tailscale address; 8701,8702,6081,6082 bind host loopback; 5900 and 9222 are browser-container loopback only; 9223 is Bot-private; 8642 and File Bridge are absent.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop the unexpected listener, restore reviewed bind configuration, and fail release.

requirements.requirement: Verify nftables inbound default drop and allowed traffic only on loopback, established flows, and approved tailscale0 paths.
pass_criteria: Ruleset exactly implements locked policy and direct probes to all VM non-loopback addresses on backend/control ports fail.
failure_rollback_behavior: Apply reviewed deny-first rules through private console; stop services if safe rollback cannot be proved.

requirements.requirement: Verify Tailscale default-deny identity/device policy and prohibited sharing features.
pass_criteria: Johan approved device reaches only TCP 22/443; unauthorized principal reaches neither; Funnel, public Serve/share, Tailscale SSH, exit node, and subnet routing are disabled.
failure_rollback_behavior: Revoke node/routes, disable proxy and SSH until policy is corrected, and fail release.

requirements.requirement: Verify authenticated private SSH and Desktop HTTP/WebSocket access through Tailscale and reject unauthenticated or cross-Bot routing.
pass_criteria: Approved device succeeds with application authentication; unauthenticated requests fail; each Bot origin maps only to its own loopback backend.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable incorrect route/auth configuration and restore last known-good proxy policy.

requirements.requirement: Verify loss of Tailscale removes administration and takeover without enabling fallback public access or interrupting safe outbound gateway work.
pass_criteria: SSH/Desktop/takeover become unavailable, public probes remain denied, and existing safe Telegram/routine processing behavior matches policy.
failure_rollback_behavior: Restore tailnet path through provider console; never open public fallback; fail release on exposure.

requirements.requirement: Verify systemd/launchd installation, identities, modes, command lines, immutable image pins, limits, and restart policies.
pass_criteria: Each server Bot has one non-root gateway and one serve --isolated; laptop-worker has one launchd gateway and one Desktop-managed isolated serve only while Desktop is open; no duplicate writer exists.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop duplicates, disable affected Bot, restore reviewed units, and fail release.

requirements.requirement: Kill each server gateway process and measure supervised recovery.
pass_criteria: Each gateway returns healthy with one PID and resumes polling/scheduling in 120 seconds or less without duplicate turns.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable crash-looping unit, preserve state/evidence, and restore last known-good unit/image.

requirements.requirement: Kill each server serve process and measure supervised recovery.
pass_criteria: Each serve returns authenticated and healthy with one PID in 120 seconds or less and profile integrity passes.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable affected Desktop route and restore last known-good unit/image.

requirements.requirement: Kill browser, lease supervisor, proxy, and rootless runtime components independently.
pass_criteria: Affected component recovers in 120 seconds or less where safe; browser ownership enters RECOVERING; no cross-Bot restart or unsafe control occurs.
failure_rollback_behavior: Keep browser control disabled, isolate failed Bot, and restore component from pinned artifact.

requirements.requirement: Reboot the Azure VM and verify ordered fleet recovery.
pass_criteria: Within 10 minutes of reboot all host and Bot health gates pass; gateway precedes serve; browser begins RECOVERING; no duplicate processes/listeners or lost durable state.
failure_rollback_behavior: Keep unattended routines and Desktop disabled; diagnose boot ordering and restore last known-good host snapshot if required.

requirements.requirement: Verify maintenance quiescence and restart order.
pass_criteria: New work drains/rejects, gateway and serve stop, no profile DB/WAL descriptor remains, maintenance runs, then gateway health passes before serve starts.
failure_rollback_behavior: Abort maintenance before writes or restore pre-maintenance snapshot; keep both processes stopped if state is uncertain.

requirements.requirement: Verify exactly one gateway owns Telegram polling and cron for each profile and serve owns neither.
pass_criteria: No multiplex gateway, standalone cron, second gateway, CLI/chat writer, or messaging-enabled serve exists.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop all writers for affected profile, repair ownership, run DB integrity check, then start gateway before serve.

requirements.requirement: Stress simultaneous gateway, Desktop, and cron state writes for the pinned version on every profile.
pass_criteria: All correlation markers have exactly one correctly attributed reply; no lost/cross-attributed turn, busy/corruption error, duplicate handling, or unhealthy DB/WAL after restart.
failure_rollback_behavior: Reject pinned version/pairing; disable affected Desktop backend and restore fixture state.

requirements.requirement: Verify provider/model pin for live turns and routines.
pass_criteria: Only openai-codex with gpt-5.6-sol is configured and observed; no fallback provider/model is enabled.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable turns/routines until exact pin is restored.

requirements.requirement: Verify routine schedule ownership, deduplication, result recording, and restart catch-up policy.
pass_criteria: Each due occurrence runs at most once under its owner, records outcome/correlation, and restart causes neither silent loss nor duplicate execution.
failure_rollback_behavior: Pause affected schedule, reconcile from durable ledger, and require approval for uncertain side-effect retry.

requirements.requirement: Verify approved inbound Telegram message admission and outbound reply for each mapped server Bot.
pass_criteria: Allowlisted numeric user/chat receives exactly one attributed reply from mapped owner; no public webhook/listener exists.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable mapping, preserve sanitized IDs/digests only, and repair gateway admission.

requirements.requirement: Verify unauthorized, unpaired, wrong-chat, and cross-Bot Telegram routing attempts are denied.
pass_criteria: Every unauthorized fixture yields no Bot turn, no side effect, and a sanitized deny event.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable affected gateway and revoke mapping until admission is repaired.

requirements.requirement: Verify changing Channel owner derives a same-owner opaque credential handle and rejects mismatched ownership.
pass_criteria: Messages route only to selected owner; cross-owner handle and nonnumeric authority identifiers are rejected.
failure_rollback_behavior: Rollback mapping atomically to prior owner; do not copy credentials.

requirements.requirement: Verify Telegram outbound errors, retry limits, attribution, and idempotency do not duplicate a message.
pass_criteria: A bounded outage yields either one confirmed outbound message or a failed outcome; never more than one; alert/evidence is sanitized.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop retry after bound, retain original idempotency key, and require state inspection before fresh approval where applicable.

requirements.requirement: Verify persona, identity, model, instructions, memory mode, capabilities, skill assignment, routine, and runtime survive restart for each Bot.
pass_criteria: Each Bot returns its own expected non-secret configuration after restart with no default-profile fallback.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable mismatched Bot and restore its Bot-scoped R1 backup.

requirements.requirement: Verify memory and canonical session persistence and attribution across gateway/serve restart.
pass_criteria: Seeded non-secret marker remains only in owning Bot memory/session and replies preserve Bot/session attribution.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop both processes, run integrity checks, restore owning Bot only, and investigate leakage as incident.

requirements.requirement: Verify skills and tools are allowlisted per Bot and unavailable to Bots lacking assignment.
pass_criteria: Assigned harmless skill succeeds; unassigned and cross-Bot capability invocation fails before execution.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable capability broker for affected Bot and restore reviewed allowlist.

requirements.requirement: Verify credential handles and broker use are Bot-, purpose-, adapter-, and destination-scoped without value disclosure.
pass_criteria: Owner operation succeeds through broker; cross-Bot/scope/destination/direct-egress attempts fail; seeded canary is absent from environment, argv, files, outputs, logs, sessions, and evidence.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable/revoke handle, quarantine evidence, rotate seeded credential, and fail release.

requirements.requirement: Verify each Bot workspace, HOME, profile root, download release path, and terminal cwd are exact and non-shared.
pass_criteria: Every resolved path and mount matches locked topology; another Bot root, host home/admin socket, and installation default profile are absent.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop affected container and rebuild mounts from reviewed manifest.

requirements.requirement: Verify Unix users, rootless containers, networks, process visibility, ownership, permissions, capabilities, sandbox, and resource limits isolate server Bots.
pass_criteria: Cross-Bot filesystem/network/DNS/process/audit-write probes fail; containers are non-root/unprivileged, sandboxed, capability-dropped, socket-free, and bounded.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop compromised boundary, preserve metadata, rebuild Bot container set and rotate its credentials.

requirements.requirement: Verify Browser Profile, credential, session, memory, workspace, download, audit, and backup namespaces never leak between Bots.
pass_criteria: Every owner-tagged canary is visible only to its owner and every cross-owner read/write fails.
failure_rollback_behavior: Treat any leak as security incident; disable both Bots, rotate affected credentials, restore from known-clean points.

requirements.requirement: Verify test-worker has test-only authority and cannot resolve production accounts, handles, or data.
pass_criteria: No production credential/account/data reference is configured or resolvable.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable test-worker and revoke any excessive grant immediately.

requirements.requirement: Verify each canonical Bot Chat persists, routes to exactly its owner, and shows stable Bot/session attribution.
pass_criteria: Messages and replies remain in the owning canonical chat across reconnect/restart with no cross-profile attribution.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable incorrect backend route and restore prior chat mapping.

requirements.requirement: Verify Room membership and transcript attribution do not merge profiles, credentials, memory, or authority.
pass_criteria: Only members receive eligible dispatch; transcript attributes every response; member data boundaries remain intact.
failure_rollback_behavior: Close fixture Room, revert membership, and fail on any state leakage.

requirements.requirement: Verify mentions dispatch only named online members and unmentioned routing is bounded.
pass_criteria: Mention reaches exactly named member; nonmember/offline Bot is not dispatched; unmentioned message terminates within configured bounded rounds without loop.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop Room routing and preserve transcript metadata for diagnosis.

requirements.requirement: Verify direct and Room delegation retains target runtime permissions, credentials, availability, and approvals.
pass_criteria: Target receives task/result correlation but gains no source authority; denied target action remains denied.
failure_rollback_behavior: Cancel delegation and quarantine result if target identity/authority is ambiguous.

requirements.requirement: Verify server routines execute while Hermes Desktop clients are closed.
pass_criteria: Due server routine completes once with Desktop closed and records owner/result.
failure_rollback_behavior: Pause routine and repair gateway ownership; do not introduce a second scheduler.

requirements.requirement: Verify server routines continue while the Mac is off and Mac-bound work degrades explicitly.
pass_criteria: Server-only routine completes; Mac-bound delegation reports laptop_unavailable within 60 seconds and causes no Mac mutation.
failure_rollback_behavior: Keep Mac work queued/failed per declared policy and never redirect it to server filesystem authority.

requirements.requirement: Verify laptop-worker routine behavior while Desktop is closed, Mac is awake, and Mac later sleeps.
pass_criteria: Launchd gateway owns cron with Desktop closed; safe read-only routine can run awake; sleep/offline mutation fails closed and records outcome.
failure_rollback_behavior: Pause laptop routine and require fresh local approval after recovery.

requirements.requirement: Verify headed Chromium visual output over authenticated tailnet-only noVNC with raw VNC/CDP unreachable from host, tailnet, and Internet.
pass_criteria: Approved view shows current Bot browser; noVNC input is off outside HUMAN; raw ports fail from every non-container source.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable proxy/browser route and enter RECOVERING until exposure is removed.

requirements.requirement: Verify Bot-scoped browser cookies/local storage/session and benign page state survive normal browser and VM restart.
pass_criteria: Seeded disposable session survives restart only for its Bot; browser starts RECOVERING and later passes harmless probe.
failure_rollback_behavior: Keep automation disabled and restore same-Bot browser snapshot or require fresh login.

requirements.requirement: Verify legal takeover transitions AUTOMATION to DRAINING to HUMAN to RECOVERING to AUTOMATION.
pass_criteria: Each transition is audited; CDP clients reach zero before HUMAN; each transition completes within 60 seconds; one admin controls input; recovery rotates lease and passes probe.
failure_rollback_behavior: Revoke grant/input, close CDP/VNC, remain RECOVERING, and alert.

requirements.requirement: Verify simultaneous automation and human input is impossible during races and concurrent takeover claims.
pass_criteria: At every sample at most one control plane is enabled; one claimant wins or all fail closed; stale nonce and invalid transition fail.
failure_rollback_behavior: Revoke all leases and grants, enter RECOVERING, and alert.

requirements.requirement: Verify HUMAN disconnect, abandonment, ten-minute timeout, and proxy/session loss revoke input and enter RECOVERING.
pass_criteria: All cases deny CDP/noVNC input after event, revoke credential, and enter RECOVERING within 60 seconds.
failure_rollback_behavior: Remain RECOVERING and require a new approved takeover after safe recovery.

requirements.requirement: Verify browser/supervisor restart or reboot during HUMAN never resumes human or automation control implicitly.
pass_criteria: After restart state is RECOVERING, all prior credentials/nonces fail, and both input paths remain denied until checklist passes.
failure_rollback_behavior: Keep browser disabled and rebuild supervisor state if recovery cannot prove safety.

requirements.requirement: Verify takeover bootstrap and evidence contain no credential in URL, history, logs, screenshot, CDP, crash report, page JavaScript, or agent context.
pass_criteria: Credential arrives only through authenticated no-store bootstrap; seeded canary is absent from every inspected sink.
failure_rollback_behavior: Deny takeover, quarantine sinks, rotate credential, and treat disclosure as incident.

requirements.requirement: Verify profile concurrency lock prevents two Chromium owners and detects stale locks without cloning profile state.
pass_criteria: Second owner fails before profile write; original remains healthy; stale-lock recovery enters RECOVERING and preserves integrity.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop both processes, validate profile, restore same-Bot snapshot if damaged.

requirements.requirement: Verify cross-Bot Browser Profile, account, downloads, private network, and lease leakage is denied.
pass_criteria: Cross-Bot filesystem/CDP/noVNC/account canaries all fail and neither profile changes.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable both browsers, rotate affected sessions, and restore known-clean same-Bot snapshots.

requirements.requirement: Verify disposable login and logout exercise uses a non-production account and leaves no credential in evidence.
pass_criteria: Login persists for owning Bot, is unavailable cross-Bot, logout/revocation invalidates session, and evidence contains no credential/cookie content.
failure_rollback_behavior: Revoke fixture account/session, destroy fixture profile, and quarantine unsafe evidence.

requirements.requirement: Verify native laptop-worker profile, fixed cwd/HOME, one launchd gateway, Desktop-managed isolated serve, FileVault, and no server Browser Profile or Azure mount.
pass_criteria: Configuration exactly matches locked Mac boundary and no second gateway/serve/general remote filesystem service exists.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop laptop-worker service and restore reviewed Mac configuration using Mac-local approval.

requirements.requirement: Verify delegated read of a regular fixture inside each registered approved root.
pass_criteria: Read returns exact fixture digest with attribution and no mutation; unregistered Projects children are not readable.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable read adapter if confinement cannot be proved.

requirements.requirement: Verify permanent denial of sensitive roots, credential files, browser profiles, personal folders, and active-profile credentials through general tools.
pass_criteria: Every direct and delegated read/write/list attempt is denied before content disclosure.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable laptop-worker and investigate any disclosure as security incident.

requirements.requirement: Verify symlink, alias, hard-link, mount/device swap, parent traversal, case/Unicode ambiguity, special file, and path race cannot escape an approved root.
pass_criteria: Every escape/race is denied and no out-of-root content or metadata is read or changed.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable adapter and preserve filesystem metadata for investigation.

requirements.requirement: Verify every Mac mutation requires exact local single-use approval and changes exactly one fixture.
pass_criteria: Create/write/rename/copy/delete/metadata/process/install/config fixtures each pause locally; one grant authorizes exactly one unchanged target and replay fails.
failure_rollback_behavior: Leave target unchanged or reconcile partial result; reuse idempotency key but require fresh manifest/grant for retry.

requirements.requirement: Verify Telegram, Room, server, cron, reviewed manifest, and standing authority cannot approve a Mac mutation.
pass_criteria: All nonlocal approval attempts yield no mutation and a sanitized deny event.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable mutation adapter on any bypass.

requirements.requirement: Verify mutation target changes and concurrent approval consumers fail closed.
pass_criteria: Fingerprint change yields zero writes; concurrent consumers yield at most one write and exactly one durable grant consumption.
failure_rollback_behavior: Quarantine ambiguous operation, inspect state, and require fresh local approval.

requirements.requirement: Verify sleep, lock, logout, offline, approval UI loss, audit-full, and timeout stop Mac reads when confinement is uncertain and all mutations.
pass_criteria: Every mutation leaves fixture unchanged; availability changes to laptop_unavailable within 60 seconds; no remote fallback occurs.
failure_rollback_behavior: Restore local prerequisites manually; require fresh approval after recovery.

requirements.requirement: Verify reconnect discovery and reconciliation does not execute stale or queued mutations.
pass_criteria: Reachability and task ledger reconcile within 5 minutes; stale grants remain invalid; reads may resume; every mutation requires fresh local approval.
failure_rollback_behavior: Keep laptop-worker unavailable and reconcile manually if ledger identity is uncertain.

requirements.requirement: Verify latest successful encrypted scheduled R1 configuration backup for each server Bot is no more than 24 hours old (RPO 24h).
pass_criteria: Each Bot has a checksum-valid manifest and encrypted private restore point age <=24h; failed/missing job alerts.
failure_rollback_behavior: Pause release; run approved backup after diagnosing cause; never substitute an unverified point.

requirements.requirement: Verify latest browser-consistent encrypted snapshot for each server Bot is no more than 24 hours old.
pass_criteria: Each Browser Profile has an encrypted same-Bot restore point age <=24h captured under proven consistency protocol.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable browser automation until a valid snapshot exists.

requirements.requirement: Verify R1 export projection excludes R3, Browser Profile, live DB handles, special links/files, and other Bot roots.
pass_criteria: Backup principal sees only prepared read-only R1 tree; every excluded canary and cross-Bot path is absent; write is limited to one Bot prefix.
failure_rollback_behavior: Revoke backup principal, delete unsafe staged copy, rotate exposed credentials, and fail release.

requirements.requirement: Restore test-worker R1 and R2 into a clean isolated target without stopping or altering chief.
pass_criteria: Restore completes within RTO 4 hours; checksums, ownership, modes, DB/WAL health, one-gateway/one-serve contract, identity/persona, memory/session, skills/routines, browser state, and service smoke tests pass; chief before/after digests match.
failure_rollback_behavior: Destroy isolated target; keep production untouched; choose earlier verified point or fix runbook and repeat.

requirements.requirement: Verify restored browser starts RECOVERING and completes the recovery checklist before automation.
pass_criteria: Prior leases/takeover credentials fail; profile health, known tab/window, rotated nonce, and harmless probe pass before AUTOMATION.
failure_rollback_behavior: Keep restored browser disabled and repeat same-Bot restore or require fresh login.

requirements.requirement: Verify rollback selects a known-good Bot-scoped point, quiesces both processes, validates before cutover, and never rolls one Bot state into another.
pass_criteria: Failed canary deployment returns to pre-change identity/state with checksums and service health; unrelated Bot remains unchanged.
failure_rollback_behavior: Keep affected Bot disabled and escalate to isolated restore; never perform in-place speculative repair.

requirements.requirement: Verify fleet health covers host, disk, credit, gateway, serve, scheduler, provider, browser recovery, backup/restore, tailnet, and Mac reachability.
pass_criteria: Every required signal has owner, cadence, threshold, last success, and sanitized runbook link; stale/missing checks are unhealthy.
failure_rollback_behavior: Fail release and disable unattended work for unmonitored critical components.

requirements.requirement: Inject each alert condition and verify Telegram alert delivery.
pass_criteria: Every injected condition produces one correctly attributed Telegram alert within 5 minutes containing only event ID, Bot, safe reason code, and time.
failure_rollback_behavior: Use secondary human monitoring path, disable unattended work, and repair alerts before release.

requirements.requirement: Verify audit/evidence archive encryption, immutability, redaction, chain integrity, and retention.
pass_criteria: Production configuration retains encrypted evidence for 400 days; public access is off; secret canaries absent; daily/monthly verification and lifecycle authorization controls pass.
failure_rollback_behavior: Block high-impact operations, quarantine unsafe evidence, repair chain/archive, and rotate exposed credentials.

requirements.requirement: Inject gateway kill using a bounded disposable fixture.
pass_criteria: gateway stops side effects, recovers healthy within 120 seconds, and does not duplicate work.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop injection, restore last known-good state using component runbook, verify isolation/final health, and fail release on any unsafe or threshold-violating outcome.

requirements.requirement: Inject serve kill using a bounded disposable fixture.
pass_criteria: Desktop becomes unavailable then authenticated healthy within 120 seconds without affecting gateway.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop injection, restore last known-good state using component runbook, verify isolation/final health, and fail release on any unsafe or threshold-violating outcome.

requirements.requirement: Inject browser crash using a bounded disposable fixture.
pass_criteria: lease enters RECOVERING and non-browser Bot work remains available.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop injection, restore last known-good state using component runbook, verify isolation/final health, and fail release on any unsafe or threshold-violating outcome.

requirements.requirement: Inject lease supervisor kill using a bounded disposable fixture.
pass_criteria: CDP/noVNC input are denied, RECOVERING is recorded, and alert arrives within 5 minutes.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop injection, restore last known-good state using component runbook, verify isolation/final health, and fail release on any unsafe or threshold-violating outcome.

requirements.requirement: Inject reverse proxy kill using a bounded disposable fixture.
pass_criteria: private UI/takeover fail unavailable without public fallback and recover within 120 seconds.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop injection, restore last known-good state using component runbook, verify isolation/final health, and fail release on any unsafe or threshold-violating outcome.

requirements.requirement: Inject provider auth/quota/outage using a bounded disposable fixture.
pass_criteria: turn and routine fail with no fallback and sanitized alert arrives within 5 minutes.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop injection, restore last known-good state using component runbook, verify isolation/final health, and fail release on any unsafe or threshold-violating outcome.

requirements.requirement: Inject backup failure or stale point using a bounded disposable fixture.
pass_criteria: freshness becomes unhealthy, restore is blocked, and alert arrives within 5 minutes.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop injection, restore last known-good state using component runbook, verify isolation/final health, and fail release on any unsafe or threshold-violating outcome.

requirements.requirement: Inject audit collector/archive lag/disk full using a bounded disposable fixture.
pass_criteria: side effects, approvals, secrets, Mac mutation, and takeover fail closed while bounded diagnostics remain.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop injection, restore last known-good state using component runbook, verify isolation/final health, and fail release on any unsafe or threshold-violating outcome.

requirements.requirement: Inject secret broker or policy gate kill using a bounded disposable fixture.
pass_criteria: credential use and side effects stop with no value disclosure or bypass.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop injection, restore last known-good state using component runbook, verify isolation/final health, and fail release on any unsafe or threshold-violating outcome.

requirements.requirement: Inject Telegram outage using a bounded disposable fixture.
pass_criteria: retry is bounded and produces no duplicate outbound message.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop injection, restore last known-good state using component runbook, verify isolation/final health, and fail release on any unsafe or threshold-violating outcome.

requirements.requirement: Inject Mac sleep/offline/reconnect using a bounded disposable fixture.
pass_criteria: laptop_unavailable is reported within 60 seconds and reconciliation completes within 5 minutes without stale mutation.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop injection, restore last known-good state using component runbook, verify isolation/final health, and fail release on any unsafe or threshold-violating outcome.

requirements.requirement: Inject VM reboot using a bounded disposable fixture.
pass_criteria: entire fleet returns healthy within 10 minutes in safe start order.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop injection, restore last known-good state using component runbook, verify isolation/final health, and fail release on any unsafe or threshold-violating outcome.

requirements.requirement: Inject Tailscale loss using a bounded disposable fixture.
pass_criteria: admin/takeover access stops and no public listener appears.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop injection, restore last known-good state using component runbook, verify isolation/final health, and fail release on any unsafe or threshold-violating outcome.

requirements.requirement: Inject takeover abandon/race/reboot using a bounded disposable fixture.
pass_criteria: both control paths fail closed to RECOVERING and transition completes within 60 seconds.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop injection, restore last known-good state using component runbook, verify isolation/final health, and fail release on any unsafe or threshold-violating outcome.

requirements.requirement: Inject profile DB/WAL contention fixture using a bounded disposable fixture.
pass_criteria: concurrent interfaces produce no corruption, duplicate, lost, or cross-attributed state.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop injection, restore last known-good state using component runbook, verify isolation/final health, and fail release on any unsafe or threshold-violating outcome.

requirements.requirement: Inject restore-point corruption fixture using a bounded disposable fixture.
pass_criteria: checksum validation rejects point before cutover and production remains unchanged.
failure_rollback_behavior: Stop injection, restore last known-good state using component runbook, verify isolation/final health, and fail release on any unsafe or threshold-violating outcome.

requirements.requirement: Create an additional disposable server Bot from the documented runbook without copying live state.
pass_criteria: Unique profile/Unix user/container network/workspace/credentials/Browser Profile/ports/routes/backup prefix are created from reviewed manifests; default profile and existing Bots remain unchanged.
failure_rollback_behavior: Destroy additional Bot fixture with audited cleanup; repair runbook/manifests.

requirements.requirement: Remove the additional Bot using the retirement runbook and prove resource/credential/audit retention behavior.
pass_criteria: Services/routes are absent, credentials revoked, mutable state removed, retained evidence follows 400-day policy, and existing Bot health/digests are unchanged.
failure_rollback_behavior: Keep fixture disabled and complete approved cleanup manually; never delete immutable evidence early.

requirements.requirement: Validate the capability parity register against current implementation and official-source snapshots.
pass_criteria: Every requested capability is classified native, implemented equivalent, or unsupported; each claim links evidence/version; no simulated/prototype behavior is presented as production.
failure_rollback_behavior: Fail release for any unclassified, overstated, or stale claim.

requirements.requirement: Verify Grok-only and vendor-only capabilities remain explicitly unsupported unless a tested equivalent exists: managed user VM, integrated Agent Computer takeover, secure masked-secret handoff, universal Auto Review rules, first-party iPhone client, teach-by-demonstration, and x.ai public Bot-sharing links.
pass_criteria: Every named vendor-only capability is present in the gap register; each states user impact, safe degraded behavior, source/version, tracking issue/owner, and no silent substitute or parity claim.
failure_rollback_behavior: Disable/label affected UI and documentation claim; do not waive the gate by skipping.

requirements.requirement: Verify File Bridge and any other deferred component is absent from listeners, mounts, routing, and capability claims.
pass_criteria: No File Bridge listener/mount/general remote shell exists and UI/docs state delegation-only Mac access until separately accepted.
failure_rollback_behavior: Remove undeclared component and treat unexpected Mac exposure as incident.

requirements.requirement: Run all non-destructive live health and negative-boundary probes after failure cleanup and restore drills.
pass_criteria: All required services, private access, Bot boundaries, gateways, schedulers, Channels, Desktop, Rooms, routines, browsers, laptop status, backups, monitoring, and alerts are healthy with no active recovery/incident state.
failure_rollback_behavior: Do not release; rollback affected change or restore affected Bot and repeat dependent requirements.

requirements.requirement: Assemble and sign the release evidence manifest and compute the binary production decision.
pass_criteria: Every catalog ID has exactly one current PASS result, no BLOCKED/SKIPPED/FAIL result, all artifacts verify by digest, evidence is encrypted/redacted, and production decision is PASS.
failure_rollback_behavior: Production decision is FAIL; unattended routines and production enablement remain blocked.
